task_description: Build the entire PM2 process monitor and control-panel application from scratch per .agents/tasks/design.md: a Node 20 + TypeScript (strict) service that connects to the local PM2 daemon, keeps an in-memory state hub of processes/metrics/errors, serves a REST API and a vanilla-JS dashboard over Express, pushes live updates over a ws WebSocket, tracks and dedups errors, and raises configurable alerts via MS Teams webhooks and SMTP email. Must build with zero tsc strict errors and boot gracefully with PM2 not installed.
